disposition_why: 'NOTHING_SHELVED' has now stopped cloud-upload on 8 consecutive runs (limit 7), so it is not resolving itself. Seven consecutive days with the same queued episodes still not shelved. Read the stop's FIRST LINE before blaming the Mac: 'N render(s) shelved without a thumbnail: <slugs>' means the Mac rendered and pushed but built no thumbnail (detail.shelved_without_thumbnail) - on the Mac, .venv/bin/python visuals/thumbs_for.py <slugs> && bin/push-to-r2.sh <slugs>. The heartbeat sentence (detail.mac_heartbeat) says when the batch last ran and how many renders are finished, so a Mac that is producing but behind the queue reads as behind, not stuck. Only when neither applies read the '=== batch session' block in ~/Library/Logs/how-we-know/batch.log: if 'to narrate' or 'to render' lists the slugs, narration or rendering is the slow part; if both say none and the renders exist, bin/push-to-r2.sh is.
